37Sensor::Sensor(int signalGpioPin, EventHandler* parentHandler)
38 : pin(signalGpioPin), eventHandler(parentHandler) {}

44void Sensor::on(Event event) {
45 // 1. Execute concrete sensor reading and validation logic
46 processEvent(event);
47
48 // 2. Performance Guard: If event mutation sets ID to -1, propagation terminates early
49 if (event.identifier == -1)
50 return;
51
52 // 3. Automatically push event upstream to the registered mediator device
53 if (eventHandler != nullptr) {
54 eventHandler->on(event);
55 }
56}
